description: With no PHYSICAL LINK BREAK CONFIRM, the Initiator repeats PHYSICAL LINK BREAK at each expiry of its derived break timer and, after cas.break_retries repeats, declares the link broken anyway.
note: Link setup as cas/make-called-accept: the peer's PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST (Ed4) at 2000, our PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED out at 52000, and the link made when that transmission ends at 57550 (B-0213, B-0400): link_state linked and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 (B-0215). The peer is recorded Ed4 (B-0408) and the 16-bit family is in force. At 61000 the peer's DATA-ONLY (FSN 0) carries a PHYSICAL LINK BREAK REQUEST with reason 2, Channel Share (octets 62 00, B-0171): cas.first_data stops, link_state closing, no new C_PDUs (B-0245, B-0423). The ACK-ONLY goes at 78000 and when it has been sent, at 83550, the link is clean (B-0422): link_state breaking and PHYSICAL LINK BREAK with reason 0, as B-0302 maps Channel Share (B-0423), octet 40, out at 131550 after the VDCD LBT wait (K-0074) and 45000 ms of contention. cas.break_timeout_ms is not set, so cas.break runs for the derived value, one answer wait, here dts.ack_wait_ms 60000 (B-0420, C-1120), from the end of that transmission at 137100 (B-0283, B-0400). No confirm comes. At 197100 it expires and PHYSICAL LINK BREAK is sent again (B-0287): LBT 3000 after our own transmission, contention 36000 ms, out at 236100 as a new C_PDU, ID 2 (B-0424); cas.break again from 241650. At 301650 it expires once more; cas.break_retries is 1, so two sends were all, and the link is declared broken anyway (B-0288): link_state unlinked, D_CONNECTION_TERMINATED to the DTS, C_PHYSICAL_LINK_BROKEN to the SIS. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133). A CAS-1 C_PDU of one octet in a type 8 D_PDU fills a block exactly (25 bytes; EOT and reception window 10), C_PDU IDs from 0 in each node's own sequence (C-1040), EOW 0. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080). The soft link times are set to 3600000 so that no SIS close falls within the run; the SIS starts sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only), sis.soft_link_max and sis.soft_link_idle when the link is made, and stops the idle wait while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326).
